endorsements.name: Mateusz Jurczyk
endorsements.label: Practical Exploitation of Registry Vulnerabilities in the Windows Kernel
endorsements.description: The registry is a very prominent but largely unexplored local attack surface in the Windows kernel. It has all the qualities of an attractive research target: it is over 30 years old, written in C, highly complex, and generally reachable from unprivileged user-mode contexts. Read more
